newsitem.title: GERMANY: Five German soldiers charged after racist attack.
newsitem.headline: Five German soldiers charged after racist attack.

text.p: German prosecutors on Monday charged five soldiers with grevious bodily harm and forming an armed gang, following a racist attack on three foreigners last month.

Police arrested nine men after masked soldiers in uniform and helmets went on the rampage in the western town of Detmold and threatened an Italian with a knife and clubbed two Turks with baseball bats, shouting racist abuse.
The foreigners were treated in hospital for head injuries.

The trial of the five main suspects is due to begin in May and separate proceedings will be brought against the four other soldiers, who are also suspected of taking part in the attack, but not of inflicting bodily harm.
The army said the suspects had all just joined the army and most of them were from former communist east Germany. Six of the soldiers were dismissed from the army.
Hundreds of people protested in Detmold after the attack and Defence Minister Volker Ruehe ordered a special inquiry.
